strings.downloadnotavailable: Unable to connect to the download server. It is not possible to install or update the language packs automatically. Please download the appropriate ZIP file(s) from {$a->src} and unzip them manually to your data directory {$a->dest}
strings.installpending: The following language packs will be installed soon: {$a}.
strings.langimportdisabled: Language import feature has been disabled. You have to update your language packs manually at the file-system level. Do not forget to purge string caches after you do so.
strings.langpacknotremoved: An error has occurred; language pack '{$a}' is not completely uninstalled. Please check file permissions.
strings.langunsupported:
Your server does not seem to fully support the following languages:

    {$a->missinglocales}

Instead, the global locale ({$a->globallocale}) will be used to format certain strings such as dates or numbers.
strings.noenglishuninstall: The English language pack cannot be uninstalled.
strings.nolangupdateneeded: All your language packs are up to date, no update is needed
strings.privacy:metadata: The Language packs plugin does not store any personal data.
strings.uninstallconfirm: You are about to completely uninstall these language packs: {$a}. Are you sure?
strings.updatelangsnote: Updating all installed language packs by clicking the button can take a long time and lead to timeouts. It is recommended instead to make use of the scheduled task '{$a->taskname}' (which runs by default every day).
